name: Nizar_PR_Rule
observations: NEVER display PR content, details, or GitHub API responses in the chat. The user does NOT want to see PR output in VS Code.
When merging to main: create PR AND merge it immediately in the same step — silently. No intermediate output.
Workflow: create PR → merge (squash) → close issue → report only the final result (e.g. 'Merged and closed #12 and #13').
This is a HARD RULE — no exceptions. The user has repeated this multiple times.
